ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: in the figure, the title of Landscape A is labeled as “A: Wujiang Gorge,” and the picture shows a gorge landform with steep mountain slopes on both sides and a narrow valley in the middle. Therefore, the main external force that formed the landform shown in Figure A is the erosive action of flowing water.
